source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Run MLPerf v5.0 Llama 3.1 405B Server and compare with MLCommons v5.0.
procedure_facts: Source says download training_results_v5.0 but executes an inference-style `--benchmarks=llama3.1-405b --scenarios=server` command.
Criteria text incorrectly asks for valid BERT performance.
criteria_facts: MLPerf inference executes without error and score is compared with MLCommons.
source_conflicts: training_results conflicts with inference criteria/Server command.
Title says Llama3-405B while command says Llama3.1-405B.
missing_source_information: Exact v5.0 Llama3.1-405B model/tokenizer/data/harness and scenario rules.
Accuracy, Server latency/throughput, compliance and comparable result/tolerance.

original_test_intent.statement: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 Llama 3.1 405B Server on the approved multi-GPU SUT, prove model-specific accuracy and latency-valid LoadGen/compliance results, and compare with a comparable v5.0 result.
must_preserve: Full multi-GPU workload and model-specific validity.
must_not_infer: MLPerf Training, BERT, Offline or a generic Llama3 model.
That any v5.0 result is comparable.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly detects training/inference, Llama3/Llama3.1 and BERT conflicts and requires licensed v5.0 Server artifacts plus accuracy/LoadGen validity.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not require tokenizer/prompt/output preprocessing identity, a named comparable system, or model-specific Server latency metrics and multi-GPU fabric evidence.

related_records: Llama2 and GPT-J rows cannot supply Llama3.1-405B artifacts or latency rules.
applicable_history.precedence_application: The inference command/criteria indicate intended Inference v5.0, but all three conflicts require formal correction.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Correct training/inference, model-name and BERT conflicts, then pin the Llama3.1-405B v5.0 Server stack, comparable result and multi-GPU limits before execution.

conditions_present: Command identifies Llama3.1-405B Server and v5.0 comparison.
missing: Correct source wording, artifacts/configs, accuracy/latency/compliance rules, reference, topology/tuning and limits.
provider: Benchmark owner corrects identity and reference.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU/fabric/NUMA/runtime/storage and inspect v5.0 artifact/result metadata.
prohibited_until_resolved: Download/run/tune, use training or BERT evidence, clear logs or PASS.
closure_evidence: Comparable Server result and validity/health rule.

revision_candidate.test_name: Run MLPerf Inference v5.0 Llama 3.1 405B Server
revision_candidate.purpose: Execute the approved MLPerf Inference v5.0 Llama 3.1 405B Server configuration, verify model-specific accuracy plus LoadGen/compliance validity, measure latency-valid Server performance, and compare only with a signed comparable v5.0 result.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exact multi-GPU SUT, GPU/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA topology, driver/runtime, v5.0 inference container/harness commit, Llama3.1-405B weights/tokenizer/evaluation data and configs. Training artifacts and other Llama variants are excluded.
revision_candidate.target_scope: All resources declared by the system configuration; Llama3.1-405B Server only. Offline, BERT, Llama2 and MLPerf Training are excluded. 240/60-minute values are planning metadata unless the signed harness defines active duration.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Corrected source; pinned v5.0 inference stack; licensed model/tokenizer/data/preprocessing hashes; configs; accuracy/performance/compliance commands; prompt/output policy; Server throughput/latency rules; comparable result ID; tuning/fabric/power/cooling and recovery limits.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Verify model/tokenizer/data/config identity and GPU/fabric baseline, then run Llama3.1-405B accuracy, Server performance and required compliance phases exactly as the pinned v5.0 inference implementation specifies. Preserve raw LoadGen/model-accuracy logs, latency validity, topology and telemetry. Do not download training_results or run BERT.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Conflicts corrected; artifacts licensed/pinned; all GPUs/fabric healthy; adequate HBM/memory/storage/cooling/power; tuning/load/recovery approved.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: System/GPU/fabric identity; all artifact/config hashes; prompt/tokenizer/preprocessing manifest; exact commands; model accuracy; complete LoadGen logs with Server throughput/latency validity; compliance; HBM/utilization/XID/ECC/NVLink/power/thermal/host logs; named result and normalized comparison; final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed v5.0 Llama3.1-405B Server rules and comparable result. Pass requires model accuracy, LoadGen/compliance and Server latency validity, numeric comparison and clean GPU/fabric/host health. Training or BERT evidence is invalid.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not mix training/inference, model versions/scenarios/releases, use unlicensed weights/data, alter tokenizer/prompts/tuning without approval, clear logs, suppress invalidity or claim official status.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Benchmark/data/software/platform owners approve identity, artifacts, reference, tuning and load; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans resolve conflicts/reference. Agent runs only the pinned Inference Server workflow.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Stop on invalidity or GPU/fabric limits, preserve evidence, terminate cleanly, restore tuning/services and verify all GPUs/fabric/host before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Any source conflict remains; wrong model/scenario/release/workload family; missing license/config/reference; accuracy/LoadGen/compliance failure; topology drift; HBM/storage/XID/ECC/link/thermal/power/host limit; evidence loss.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The validator preserved MLPerf Inference v5.0 Llama 3.1 405B Server; rejected Training, generic Llama3, BERT, Offline and release/model/tokenizer/prompt drift; required model accuracy, LoadGen latency-validity, compliance and GPU-fabric evidence; and rejected unsafe tuning, incomparable reference, false official or PASS claims. No material document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
